profile.name: Aubay Société Anonyme
profile.summary: Aubay Société Anonyme provides application services in Belgium, Luxembourg, Spain, Portugal, Italy, France, and the United Kingdom. The company offers consulting; digital experience services, such as service design thinking/design strategist, UX design/UX digital designer, UI design/UI digital designer, and product management/product owner digital; smart automation/intelligent process automation services, including audit and business process optimization, process mining, OCR and intelligent document processing, natural language processing (NLP) and natural language understanding (NLU), and machine learning/deep learning; and agility services, comprising SAFe / Less / Scrum@scale / Spotify, maturity audit, training and support, and operational agility. It also provides application services; data and analytics services, such as data strategy and consulting, data governance, data platform and architecture, data engineering, data science and AI, and modern BI & analytics; and cybersecurity services, including governance, risk, compliance council, project and development security, secure architecture, and maintenance in safety conditions, as well as audits/ penetration testing; cloud infrastructure, DevOps, the digital workplace, application management, and cybersecurity; and test and automation services, comprising IT and business testing, automation, method and tools consulting, and performance testing. The company serves banking/finance, insurance/social security, telecoms/media/gaming, energy/utilities/health, administration, transportation, and retail/luxe sectors. Aubay Société Anonyme was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, France.
profile.summary_fr: Aubay Société Anonyme fournit des services applicatifs en Belgique, au Luxembourg, en Espagne, au Portugal, en Italie, en France et au Royaume-Uni. La société propose des services de conseil, des services d'expérience numérique, tels que la conception de services, la stratégie de conception, la conception UX / UX Digital Designer, la conception UI / UI Digital Designer et la gestion de produits / Product Owner Digital; services d'automatisation intelligente / automatisation des processus, y compris l'audit et l'optimisation des processus métier, l'OCR et le traitement intelligent des documents, le traitement du langage naturel (NLP) et l'apprentissage automatique / apprentissage profond. Il fournit également des services applicatifs, des services de données et d'analyse, tels que la stratégie et le conseil en matière de données, la gouvernance des données, la plate-forme et l'architecture de données, l'ingénierie des données, la science des données et l'IA, et des services de cybersécurité, y compris la gouvernance, le risque, le conseil de conformité, la sécurité des projets et du développement, l'architecture sécurisée et la maintenance dans des conditions de sécurité.
